posting_text: Hollis Market is searching for a Category Manager for produce and dairy. You'll negotiate with suppliers, plan promotions, and track margin by SKU. Required: vendor negotiation, margin analysis, and strong Excel. Knowledge of fresh supply chains is nice to have, and so is a data visualization tool like Tableau. Early mornings during seasonal resets. We are a regional grocery chain with 48 stores, and employees tell us they stay for the people.

The Windham Power Cooperative needs a Forecasting Analyst to predict daily electricity demand. You'll maintain time-series models, validate them against actuals, and report error metrics each month. Must have time-series forecasting experience, R or Python, and an understanding of MAPE and other error measures. Familiarity with weather data feeds is a plus. Open to remote. Our cooperative has a 70-year history of community service, and employees enjoy a pension plan and generous paid time off.

Alder & Finch Insurance seeks a Financial Analyst to support monthly forecasting and variance reporting for our claims division. Required: three-statement modeling, Excel (pivot tables, lookups), and GAAP basics. You must also be comfortable presenting findings to non-finance leaders. Bonus points for Power BI or Anaplan experience. We offer generous PTO and a collaborative team of eight in Hartford. Our finance group closes the books by business day four and values people who like tidy numbers.

Ridgeway Transit seeks an Operations Research Analyst to optimize bus schedules and crew rosters. You'll build optimization and simulation models and present trade-offs to planners. Required: linear programming or mixed-integer optimization, Python, and clear presentation skills. Experience with Gurobi or CPLEX is a big plus, but not required. Familiarity with GTFS data would also help. Your work will directly shape how 80,000 riders get to work every morning, which makes the job quietly satisfying.

Business Analyst, Pelican Bay Logistics: we need someone to translate operational pain points into clear requirements and process maps. Must be able to facilitate workshops, map processes in Visio or Lucidchart, and write SQL queries to validate data. Excellent stakeholder interviewing is key. Knowledge of Lean is useful. You'll report to the Director of Process Improvement. The role is based at our Savannah headquarters with up to two remote days a week, and relocation help is available.

Juniper Lane Foods wants a Customer Insights Analyst to turn survey and loyalty-card data into recommendations for marketing. The role involves designing surveys, running segmentation analysis, and presenting insights to brand managers. You need experience with survey design, segmentation (clustering), and Excel or SPSS. Qualtrics experience is a nice extra. Hybrid in Minneapolis. Our insights team presents to the executive group monthly, so your work gets seen and used quickly.

Stonebridge Bank's risk team is hiring a Credit Risk Analyst. You will build and monitor scorecards, document model assumptions, and support regulatory reviews. Must have: strong statistics, SAS or Python for modeling, and rigorous documentation habits. Experience with Basel or CECL frameworks strongly preferred. Master's degree preferred. You'll sit on a collaborative team of nine in Charlotte, with hybrid flexibility and a strong mentoring culture.

Wildflower Collective, a nonprofit supporting local artists, seeks a Social Media Analyst. You'll track engagement across platforms, prepare monthly performance summaries, and recommend content tweaks. You must be comfortable with social analytics tools such as Sprout or Hootsuite, writing clear summaries, and basic data visualization. Video editing skills would be a lovely extra. Part-time, 25 hours a week. We are a small, scrappy team that believes in the arts, and you'll get free tickets to local gallery openings.

Pylon Software seeks a Customer Success Manager to own renewals for a book of 40 mid-market accounts. You will run quarterly business reviews, track health scores, and partner with Sales on expansions. Must have: excellent relationship-building skills, experience managing renewals, and fluency with a CRM such as Salesforce. Must be able to read basic usage dashboards. Logistics software experience is nice to have. Austin or remote.

Redshore Mobility needs a Finance Business Partner for our product division. You will translate financial results for product leaders and challenge spending assumptions. Essential skills are business case development, strong financial analysis, and credibility with senior stakeholders. Knowledge of SaaS metrics is a plus. Hybrid, with two office days per week. You'll report to the Head of Finance and join a team that has been named a top place to work three years running.

Project Coordinator wanted at Lumina Architects, a 40-person design studio. You'll track deadlines across 15 active projects, schedule client meetings, and keep budgets updated. Must be highly organized, a confident communicator with clients, and skilled in MS Project or similar scheduling tools. Basic knowledge of architectural terms is a plus. We provide training on our time-tracking system. The studio sits in a renovated warehouse with a stocked kitchen, and Friday afternoons are for team critiques over snacks.

Quillfeather Labs is looking for an Associate Product Manager for our mobile budgeting app. You'll write user stories, prioritize the backlog, and review metrics with engineering. We require experience writing product requirements, working knowledge of SQL or analytics tools, and strong stakeholder management. User research experience is a bonus, and Agile experience would be great, though we're flexible. Our team is small, so you'll ship real features within your first quarter and see the results in customers' hands.

Maplewood Hospitality Group needs an Accounts Payable Specialist for our shared services team. Day to day you will code invoices, run weekly payment batches, and reconcile vendor statements. We require experience with three-way matching, accuracy with high volumes of data entry, and proficiency in NetSuite or a comparable ERP. Familiarity with expense management tools is preferred. Some overtime during month-end close.

Granite Peak Construction - Procurement Specialist. Source materials and negotiate with subcontractors across 12 active sites. Required: - supplier negotiation - contract review - side-by-side bid comparison in spreadsheets. Helpful but not required: knowledge of construction materials, CPSM credential. You'll work closely with project managers. Hard hat provided. We offer a hybrid schedule after the first 90 days, tuition support, and a team that really does help each other through close.

Northbridge Credit Union is looking for a Data Analyst to support member retention and product teams. You'll pull data, build customer segments, and visualize trends for non-technical colleagues. Required skills: SQL, Excel, and data visualization in Tableau or Power BI. We'd also love someone who can write Python scripts to automate recurring reports (optional). Member-focused, mission-driven culture. We offer a 401(k) match, student loan support, and a hybrid schedule with two days a week at our downtown branch.

Orbit Retail Labs is hiring a Data Scientist for our recommendations team. You will prototype models, run offline evaluations, and work with engineers to ship to production. Required: Python (pandas, scikit-learn), solid grounding in machine learning, experimentation design, and SQL. PyTorch is a plus, as is e-commerce experience. Strong communication across product and engineering is expected. We run a weekly reading group, give a learning stipend, and the team is spread across Seattle and Toronto.

Fernhill Outdoors is hiring a Marketing Analyst to measure campaign performance across email, paid social, and search. You will build weekly reports and recommend budget shifts. Requirements: advanced Excel, SQL for querying our data warehouse, Google Analytics, and clear written communication. Nice to have: Tableau, some Python, and an interest in the outdoor industry. This is a hybrid role based in Denver, on a team of five.

Poppy & Pine, a growing home decor brand, wants a Digital Marketing Specialist to run paid search and shopping campaigns. You'll manage a $60k monthly budget and optimize for return on ad spend. We need hands-on Google Ads experience, the ability to read campaign analytics, and sharp copywriting for ad text. Meta Ads and email platform skills are bonuses. Remote-friendly.

Oakline Stores is hiring a Retail Analytics Manager to lead a team of four analysts. You will set priorities, coach team members, and partner with merchandising on assortment decisions. Required: people management experience, advanced SQL, experience with assortment or category analytics, and storytelling with data. Python is helpful but not required. Competitive bonus structure. The role is based at our Nashville headquarters and includes a quarterly store visit program so analysts see what customers see.

Saltmarsh Provisions' online team needs an E-commerce Analyst to monitor conversion funnels and spot drop-offs. You'll use Google Analytics 4 daily, build A/B test readouts, and partner with the web team. Required: GA4, A/B testing fundamentals, and Excel or Sheets. If you've used Looker Studio, even better, though we'll train. Must be a curious, detail-focused person who loves digging into numbers.

Atlas Ridge Brewing is hiring an FP&A Manager to lead annual budgeting and rolling forecasts. You'll manage two analysts and brief the CFO monthly. Required: budgeting and forecasting experience, advanced financial modeling, and proven coaching of junior analysts. NetSuite and Adaptive Planning are nice to have. An MBA or CPA is helpful but optional. You will be working out of our taproom headquarters, where team members get a monthly beer allowance and free lunch on Tuesdays.

Mosaic Learning is hiring a Product Analyst to understand how students use our tutoring app. You will define metrics, run funnel and cohort analysis, and share findings with product squads. Applicants must know SQL, have experience with product analytics tools such as Amplitude or Mixpanel, and be able to design experiments. Statistical modeling is nice to have, as is experience in education technology. Fully remote.

Copperline Energy's analytics group needs a BI Developer to turn utility usage data into dashboards for field and finance teams. Requirements: 3+ years building dashboards in Power BI, solid SQL, data modeling (star schema), and experience gathering requirements from stakeholders. Preferred: Azure Synapse, DAX optimization, utility-sector background. Remote within the Southeast US. Our team ships a new dashboard release every two weeks, and you will have a real say in how we standardize reports across departments.

Brightpath Telecom's sales team needs an analyst to assemble weekly reports on regional performance and commissions. You will extract data from our CRM, reconcile commission statements, and answer ad hoc questions from sales leaders. We expect solid Excel skills, working SQL, and a talent for explaining numbers simply. Power BI is a bonus. High visibility role, so accuracy matters. The team of eight sits in Tampa with flexible remote days, and commission season is a busy but fun time.

Cardinal Point Manufacturing is hiring a Treasury Analyst to manage daily cash positioning and bank relationships. You'll forecast cash flow, process wires, and reconcile accounts. Strong Excel, cash flow forecasting, knowledge of banking portals, and careful adherence to payment controls are required. Prior experience with Kyriba is a plus. You will join a treasury team of five at our Dayton headquarters, with a hybrid schedule and excellent benefits.

Cinderfall Media's finance team needs a Revenue Analyst to reconcile subscription billing and flag anomalies. You'll work with large CSV exports daily, so advanced Excel (Power Query) is a must, along with SQL. Understanding of subscription metrics such as MRR and churn is required. Looker experience preferred. Team lunch every Friday. The role reports to the Director of Finance Operations and works closely with our billing engineers during month-end.

Larkspur Advisory is hiring a Junior Consultant for our operations practice. You'll build financial models, interview client staff, and prepare slides for partners. Must have: structured problem solving, PowerPoint storytelling, and Excel modeling. Industry experience in healthcare or retail is desirable. Travel up to 50 percent. We offer structured mentorship, a generous training budget, and a supportive team that loves a good whiteboard session.

Brightside Fulfillment seeks an Operations Manager for our Reno warehouse (80 associates, two shifts). You will own safety, throughput, and labor planning. Requirements: proven team leadership, familiarity with warehouse management systems, ability to analyze KPI data, and OSHA compliance knowledge. Lean or Six Sigma certification is a nice-to-have. Bachelor's degree and 5 years of experience preferred. Must be able to lift 40 lbs.

Meridian Trust is hiring a Compliance Analyst to monitor transactions and prepare regulatory filings. The work calls for knowledge of anti-money-laundering rules, careful documentation, and the ability to investigate alerts in a case management system. Candidates must also be skilled in Excel. CAMS certification is a plus. Reports to the Chief Compliance Officer. We value integrity above all, and new hires complete a paid onboarding program in their first month.

Copperhill Systems needs a Contract Manager to draft, review, and track vendor and customer agreements. You will flag risky clauses, maintain our contract database, and coordinate approvals. Must have: contract drafting experience, risk assessment, and a systematic approach to tracking renewal dates. A paralegal certificate is helpful and CLM software familiarity is a bonus. Remote. You'll work with legal, finance, and sales, and the company offers a four-day week during the summer months.

Tidewater Freight is looking for a Supply Chain Planner to balance inventory across five regional hubs. Responsibilities include demand forecasting, weekly S&OP prep, and supplier follow-up. Candidates need working knowledge of SAP, demand forecasting methods, and strong Excel. A CPIM certification would be great but is not required, and Python is a plus. Occasional travel (10%) to our Memphis hub.

Harbor & Vale is hiring a Sales Operations Analyst to clean up pipeline data and build forecasting reports for the VP of Sales. Strong SQL is required, as is deep knowledge of Salesforce reports and dashboards. You'll also need to explain forecast changes in plain language to sales managers. Python is not required, we'll teach you if you're curious. Our team is small, friendly, and mostly remote.

Bluejay Health Partners is hiring an HR Operations Coordinator to keep our 600-person employee records accurate and compliant. You will manage onboarding paperwork, answer benefits questions, and audit HRIS data monthly. We need hands-on HRIS experience (Workday or similar), meticulous attention to detail, and discretion with confidential information. Knowledge of state leave laws is helpful. Spanish fluency a plus. You'll join a friendly four-person HR team with flexible Fridays and full benefits from day one.

Halcyon Medical Devices needs a Quality Data Analyst to review defect trends and support audits. You will build control charts, document corrective actions, and brief production leads. Required: statistical process control, Minitab or JMP, and documentation discipline under FDA guidelines. Six Sigma Green Belt is a bonus. Day shift. We offer stable hours, a clean modern facility, and tuition reimbursement for continuing education.

Beacon Learning Group seeks a Program Manager to coordinate our teacher-training initiatives across six districts. Responsibilities include managing timelines, tracking grant deliverables, and reporting outcomes to funders. We require project management experience, grant reporting skills, and comfort with data tools such as Excel or Airtable. Curriculum design background is a plus. Some travel between sites. Our team is mission-driven, flexible about hours, and thrilled to welcome someone who cares about public education.

Seabright Imports needs a Logistics Coordinator to track containers from port to warehouse. Duties include customs paperwork, carrier coordination, and updating our TMS daily. Candidates should have knowledge of import/export documentation, experience with a TMS, and strong follow-up skills with carriers. Bilingual Spanish would be an asset. Early start (6:30am) on port arrival days. We are a family-owned business of 55 people, and we promote from within whenever we can.

Fieldstone Health Analytics needs an Analytics Engineer to build clean, tested data models for our reporting team. You will write dbt models, maintain pipelines, and document tables. Required: advanced SQL, dbt, and Git. Experience with Snowflake is preferred and Python scripting is a bonus. You will work asynchronously with analysts across three time zones. Our culture is async-first with a monthly in-person day in Raleigh and an annual learning budget of $2,000.

Tamarack Pharmacy Network seeks an Inventory Analyst to reduce stockouts and expired product across 60 stores. You will analyze reorder points, build replenishment reports, and meet weekly with store managers. Needed: Excel (including macros), SQL basics, and inventory control experience. Experience with Power BI is a plus. Salary depends on experience. You'll be on a team of six reporting to our VP of Supply Chain, with hybrid options after three months.

Clearwater Staffing is looking for a payroll specialist to process weekly payroll for ~1,200 employees. you must understand multi-state tax withholding, be accurate under deadline pressure, and be skilled with payroll software (ADP or Paycor). Handling wage garnishments is part of the job, training provided. Strong Excel is helpful but not necessary. Confidentiality is essential. We're a friendly team and cross-train everyone, so vacation coverage is never a scramble. On-site in Tulsa.

Kestrel Home Goods needs a Pricing Analyst to test price changes across 3,000 SKUs. You'll design A/B price tests, analyze elasticity, and brief merchants weekly. Required: statistics (regression and hypothesis testing), R or Python, and SQL. Familiarity with retail pricing tools would help but isn't essential. We value people who ask why before building. Hybrid in Columbus. Great fit if you like variety: no two projects look alike, and the crew celebrates every topping-out with a barbecue.
